principle: Domain is a public good. Money does not buy the protocol; it funds the origin and unlocks participation.

donor.how: Funds or transfers the paid origin (ubi-chain.com) or renewal.

supporter.how: Public endorsement, review, localization, or regional learning contribution.

domainDonation.effect: Registrant may be the donor of record. Nameservers stay ns1.vercel-dns.com and ns2.vercel-dns.com. Zone remains public in dns/.

programAccess.effect: Join the stability-guarantee program: daily learn cycle, proposal queue, credit on the public ledger.
